titulo: O passado do to be: was e were: Revisão e prática da aula 19

aula.titulo: O passado do to be: was e were
aula.objetivo: Falar do passado com «was» e «were», dizer onde você estava e como foi, usar ordinais e datas, e marcar o passado com «yesterday», «last» e «ago».

itens.enunciado: Ouça e escolha.
itens.audio: We were at home last night
opcoes: We were at home last night
We was at home last night
They were at home last night
itens.gabarito: We were at home last night

itens.enunciado: Ouça e escolha.
Ouça e escreva.
itens.explicacao: Escreva: she wasn't at work yesterday.

itens.enunciado: Ouça, repita em voz alta e depois mostre a resposta.
itens.audio: We were at home last night
itens.respostaEsperada: We were at home last night.
itens.explicacao: Nós estávamos em casa ontem à noite.

itens.enunciado: Ouça e escreva.
Qual frase está correta?
Qual é a data americana de 7 de outubro?
Ouça, repita em voz alta e depois mostre a resposta.
itens.explicacao: Como foi o seu fim de semana?

itens.enunciado: Qual frase descreve a pessoa que sente tédio?
Qual é o ordinal de «5»?
I ___ at home. (estava)
Ouça, repita em voz alta e depois mostre a resposta.
itens.explicacao: Ela não estava no trabalho ontem.

itens.enunciado: ___ you at school? (você estava)
It was two days ___ . (atrás)
The movie was ___ . (chato)
Ouça, repita em voz alta e depois mostre a resposta.
Ordene: «She was not at home yesterday.»
itens.gabarito: She was not at home yesterday.

itens.enunciado: Ordene: «Were they at the party?»
Escreva 4 frases sobre ontem: onde você estava, como foi o dia e uma frase negativa.
itens.respostaEsperada: I was at work. It was a long day. I was tired. I wasn't at home in the afternoon.

itens.enunciado: Diga em que cidade e em que ano você nasceu, e onde e quando um familiar seu nasceu (I was born… / My… was born…).
itens.respostaEsperada: I was born in São José dos Campos in 1992, and my wife was born in São Paulo in 1994.

itens.enunciado: Conte onde você estava ontem de manhã (yesterday morning), ontem à tarde (yesterday afternoon) e ontem à noite (last night).
itens.respostaEsperada: Yesterday morning I was at the office, yesterday afternoon I was in a meeting, and last night I was at home with my family.

itens.enunciado: Descreva a última viagem, festa ou evento a que você foi usando It was…, There was…, There were… e uma frase negativa com wasn't / weren't.
itens.respostaEsperada: Last month I was at a conference in Rio. It was amazing, there were a lot of great speakers, there was free coffee all day, and the hotel wasn't expensive.

itens.enunciado: Faça três perguntas para um colega sobre o fim de semana passado usando How was…?, Where were you…? e Were there…?.
itens.respostaEsperada: How was your weekend? Where were you on Saturday night? Were there many people at the restaurant?

itens.enunciado: Corrija a pergunta com were e use last night para ontem à noite: Where did you were yesterday night?
itens.explicacao: Com be no passado, usa-se were antes de you, sem did. A expressão idiomática pedida para ontem à noite é last night.

itens.enunciado: Corrija: I born in São Paulo in 1993, and my sister borned in 1996.
itens.respostaEsperada: I was born in São Paulo in 1993, and my sister was born in 1996.
itens.explicacao: A expressão de nascimento é was born com I e com my sister. Não se usa borned nem born sozinho nessa frase.

itens.enunciado: Reformule com At the party, there were many people e uma segunda oração and there was great music: In the party last Saturday had many peoples and great music.
itens.respostaEsperada: At the party last Saturday, there were many people, and there was great music.
itens.explicacao: A tarefa reformula a existência na festa com at the party e separa a concordância: there were many people e there was great music. People já é plural; peoples teria outro sentido, povos.

itens.enunciado: Corrija: We was very tired after the meeting ago two hours.
itens.respostaEsperada: We were very tired after the meeting two hours ago.
itens.explicacao: Com we, usa-se were. Ago vem depois da duração: two hours ago.

itens.enunciado: Corrija: Did the hotel be near the subway station?
itens.respostaEsperada: Was the hotel near the subway station?
itens.explicacao: A pergunta no passado de be com the hotel, singular, começa com Was: Was the hotel near ...? Não se usa did ... be.

itens.enunciado: Corrija: In last week, the weather was terrible.
itens.respostaEsperada: Last week, the weather was terrible.
itens.explicacao: Last week funciona diretamente como indicação de tempo, sem in: Last week, the weather was terrible.

itens.enunciado: Esta frase tem erro? Corrija ou escreva «OK»: There wasn't much traffic this morning, so I was at the office on time.

blocos.explicacao: PASSO 1: Os três erros que mais denunciam a interferência do português neste ponto são dizer I born sem o verbo was, misturar did com was/were (Where did you were? / Did it was good?) e dizer yesterday night em vez de last night. PASSO 2: Releia a tabela e diga cada frase certa em voz alta antes de olhar o motivo.

erros.errado: I born in 1995. / Where you born?
erros.certo: I was born in 1995. / Where were you born?
erros.motivo: “Nascer” em inglês exige sempre a estrutura passiva was / were born.

erros.errado: We was tired. / You was there.
erros.certo: We were tired. / You were there.
erros.motivo: You, we, they exigem sempre were, nunca was.

erros.errado: Did you were at home? / Did it be good?
erros.certo: Were you at home? / Was it good?
erros.motivo: O verbo to be no passado não usa o auxiliar did; basta inverter Was / Were.

erros.errado: Had many people at the event.
erros.certo: There were a lot of people at the event.
erros.motivo: “Havia / Tinha” (existência no passado) é There was / There were, nunca had.
Dizemos yesterday morning / afternoon / evening, mas “ontem à noite” é last night.

erros.errado: ago two days / I arrived has two days
erros.certo: two days ago / I arrived two days ago
erros.motivo: Ago fica sempre depois da medida de tempo; o há do português não vira has.

blocos.texto: Já consigo? Contar onde eu estava e como foi um evento, viagem ou fim de semana usando was, were, wasn't, weren't. · Descrever o que havia em um lugar com there was e there were sem usar “had”. · Dizer quando e onde nasci com I was born e usar last night e ago sem erros.

blocos.enunciado: Retorno. 1. Do Capítulo 9. Complete com mustn't ou don't have to: You ____ forget your passport when you travel abroad, and you ____ print the boarding pass if you have it on your phone. 2. Do Capítulo 8 e 10. Compare o presente e o passado: Today I'm in Boston, and there's a lot of traffic. → Last week I ____ in Chicago, and ____ a lot of traffic. 3. Do Capítulo 7 e 10. Por que dizemos There was some good news yesterday (com was), mas There were a few questions after the talk (com were)?
